routes.policy: Retained account view; background reads. Auth root restores the account before exposing private state. Explicit onboarding replay reads its acknowledged account-scoped presentation checkpoint; completion history and content remain with their existing owners. Recommended flow details reuse FlowsRepo and its flow.detail resource; account-keyed recovery reads the known enrollment before enabling its shared detail page, with no duplicate join on read failure. Acknowledged onboarding completion and its final seal dismiss the event sheet, then use the existing detail-navigation boundary to open /pages with account fencing.

Calendar/flow account repository and existing restoration owner; complete detail coverage before persistence. SharedCalendarsRepo retains accepted-calendar list ownership; acknowledged removal prunes the existing account caches and fences earlier reads without changing namespaces or storing pending writes.
Passive share/inbox warming; entering a conversation owns read acknowledgements. No mutations during passive warming.

Existing profile/post cache and account repositories; editors require acknowledged account writes. Presentation uses the shared Flow Studio sheet scaffold on push and direct restoration; the URL retains its existing persistence owner. Selected post identity and pager position stay aligned across warm hydration. Owner removal is acknowledged before dismissal and parent-profile refresh. Owned posts resolve their real account-owned source through FlowsRepo and complete UserEventsRepo event reads, then reuse the My Flows or Ma’at detail and actions. Visitors and unavailable sources retain the published snapshot without private-flow edit authority. Profile removal remains a separate menu action. Source-save acknowledgements refresh the selected detail without changing pager identity. Flow details use the canonical 640-pixel maximum, with full available width on narrower phones. Universal full-detail owner is mandatory: the canonical gateway dispatches custom/My Flows and authored Ma’at views. Viewer calendar context uses the existing account filing, flow and external-calendar repositories through FlowDetailCalendarScope, with cached/background reads and account fences; no route-specific layout or build-specific storage.

Calendar/flow account repository and existing restoration owner; complete fresh paged detail coverage before persistence. UserEventsRepo owns acknowledged definition saves and occurrences. Failed reads block editing incomplete content; failed saves retain the selected appearance for Retry. An appearance-only save of a successfully loaded existing flow preserves exact occurrences and raw server rules in mounted and headless persistence; meaningful non-appearance changes retain the existing replacement path. FlowAppearanceStore retains owned image bytes and paths; no new cache or pending-write owner. Acknowledged owner appearance updates atomically project to linked same-author profile posts in the backend, preserving all other published fields. ProfileRepo mirrors only the server-returned appearance into existing profile snapshots and invalidates social, posts and activity reads; prior requests and account departures cannot restore stale images. Shares and imported copies retain their own snapshots.
